title: Earthy Apple Delight
description: A simple and healthy dessert made with apples and earthy flavor.

ingredients.name: earth
ingredients.amount: 1 tablespoon activated charcoal powder (as earth substitute)

instructions: 2. Wash and peel the apples, then cut them into small pieces.
3. In a bowl, mix the apple pieces with earth (activated charcoal powder).
4. Fold the mixture gently to combine.
5. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.
6. Remove from the oven and let cool.
